nodes.label: Vapi MCP On The Third Provider
mcpTools is a switch, not an allowlist, on Vapi
nodes.rationale: Vapi fetches the full tool list from the MCP server at call start with no per-tool narrowing field, so a second tool registered on /api/mcp is granted retroactively to every Vapi version with a non-empty mcpTools list.

nodes.label: MCP_TOKEN stored in clear in the Vapi assistant
nodes.rationale: Vapi's public API has no credential/secret-store endpoints, so server.headers.Authorization is written in and read back verbatim by GET /assistant/{id}, unlike OpenAI which redacts it.

nodes.label: Bug: mcpServerIds applied to non-ElevenLabs drivers
nodes.rationale: lock.mcpServers holds only ElevenLabs registrations, but mcpServerIdsFor was keyed on grant set alone, so a Vapi version granting the same tool would compare against an ElevenLabs server id and force a pointless PATCH every sync run; fixed by scoping mcpServerIdsFor/mcpMoved to provider === 'elevenlabs'.
